modmenu.descriptionTranslation.koreanpat: It allows you to input Hangul naturally, and the Hangul input state does not interfere with other keys.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.description: It displays Korean/English input status near the input field.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.general.des: General settings related to the indicator.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.general.sho: It displays Korean/English input status near the input field
koreanpatch.config.indicator.outline.sho: In the Korean/English indicator, the outline is displayed for readability.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.outline.rou: The outline is displayed with rounded corners.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.outline.ko_: Set the color of the outline when the input state is Korean.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.outline.en_: Set the color of the outline when the input state is English.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.outline.ime: Set the color of the outline when the input state is IME.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.outline.opa: Set the opacity of the outline color.
Set the background color when the input state is Korean.
Set the background color when the input state is English.
Set the background color when the input state is IME.
Set the opacity of the background color.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.text.ko_col: Set the text color when the input state is Korean.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.text.en_col: Set the text color when the input state is English.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.text.ime_co: Set the text color when the input state is IME.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.text.opacit: Set the opacity of the text color.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.animation.d: These are the settings that the indicator follows the text cursor position.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.animation.s: The indicator allows you to follow the text cursor position.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.animation.e:
Set the Easing function used when the indicator moves.
You can find it more easily by referring to easings.net.
koreanpatch.config.indicator.animation.s: Set the animation speed. The larger the value, the faster you follow the cursor.
